# Daily Report — 2026-08-30

## Task Completed
Add `list_incident_slas` tool — a focused shortcut that queries the `task_sla`
table scoped to `table_name=incident`. Supports optional incident number/sys_id
lookup (INC-number auto-resolved to sys_id), `has_breached` flag filter, `stage`
filter (in_progress / breached / paused / completed), and `sla_sys_id` filter.
Returns paginated `incident_slas` list with `count`, `has_more`, and `next_offset`
keys.  Registered in `service_desk`, `system_administrator`, and `full` packages.
